Author: Tensho
Name: Tensho Assistant
Description:
Everyday tools in one window (/tensho), with a guide and help on every page.

Items and storage (bags, retainers, saddlebags, armoury chest, glamour dresser, armoire), inventory
sorting rules, market listings and prices, retainer sale prices compared on a click, recipes, a crafting
simulator and solver, gathering and fishing with Eorzea time windows and weather, a map that replaces
the game map (quests, leves, FATEs, gathering points, vendors, aether currents, teleport costs), weather,
alarms and reminders, free company voyages and builds, quests and rewards, collections with how to
obtain each item, a gear planner (materia, try on, build sharing), duty and monster loot, Beastmaster
information, Fashion Report hints, Mini Cactpot, Triple Triad helpers (against NPCs only), character
stats, macro chains and a Credits page listing every source.

Network: community data (Universalis, Garland Tools, FFXIV Console Games Wiki, Teamcraft bite times,
PaissaDB open plots, and files hosted on GitHub: LuminaSupplemental, GatherBuddy, FFXIVGachaSpreadsheet)
is requested over HTTPS only when you open or hover the matching tool, click, or a setting asks for it,
with bounded replies and a disk cache. Each source has a switch in Settings > Data and sources. This plugin's own
repository is read on a click for the gallery of community tools (data only, no code) and the help
videos, and for the shared discoveries exchange on « Exchange now » or with the optional automatic exchange (off by
default), without any account. Your own sightings (places, items, the day of each; a fish caught carries
your character's exact spot) are sent to an unlisted gist linked from a public issue only after you connect
GitHub. On « Install », the optional desktop app is downloaded from this repository's releases (SHA-256
checked). No character name or id is sent; Tensho alarms and currency cap alerts go to a Discord webhook
only if you enter one (off by default), with your character's name only if you ask for it. An item's page on the wiki or the Lodestone, and partake.gg (player events), open in your browser
only on a click or a /tensho command. Reporting a problem opens a prefilled form in your browser; you read
it and send it yourself.

Actions that reach the game (teleport, applying a sort, a macro chain, writing crafting macros, opening
Try On, equipping a gear set, sending the hunt train call to the chat channel you choose) start only when you click them. Game
alarms are created with /alarm when you add an alarm with the « game alarms » setting on (off by default)
or press Send. One setting, off by default, acts without a click: wearing the title you chose for a job
when you change job. No automation of crafting, dialogues or loot, no PvP feature, no parser.

AI disclosure: the code and the icon were generated with an AI coding agent (Claude), directed and tested
in game by the author.

Languages: English and French; German and Japanese: menu titles only.
Punchline: One window for everyday tools: items, crafting, gathering, map, collections and more.

What changes for players:
- 0.1290: Gear: below or between the expansion caps, the gear list now shows pieces close to your level; at 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100, only that exact level.
- 0.1289: Gear: as Beastmaster, your weapon, shield and gear now show on the Gear page and in its search.
- 0.1288: Alarms: Edit now lets you change the time of a daily or weekly alarm, not only a one-off one.
- 0.1287: Hover prices: Ctrl+Alt now really shows the new Universalis prices, even for an item you looked at on the market board earlier.
- 0.1286: Workshop: when both an airship and a submarine are out, both now stay listed with their return alarms, whichever panel you opened last.
- 0.1285: Bank: a retainer's bags show again after reading it at the summoning bell; its gil and crystals appear on a page after the bags.
